# RentRender

> > RentRender is a comprehensive directory and comparison platform for online render farm services, helping 3D artists and studios find cloud rendering solutions for Blender, 3ds Max, Cinema 4D, Maya, and other major 3D software.

The site catalogs render farm services worldwide, providing detailed profiles with pricing information, hardware specifications, supported software (V-Ray, Cycles, Mental Ray, Maxwell, etc.), and user reviews. It organizes services by software compatibility, rendering engine, and geographic location to help users select the best rendering solution for their projects.

## Key Topics

- Blender
- 3ds Max
- V-Ray
- Cycles
- Maya
